conceptual_change: Introduce a liquidity-adjusted trend-following filter by identifying regimes of high-volatility price location, specifically targeting the 20-period rolling standard deviation of close location as an indicator of breakout momentum.
rationale: By utilizing the 20-period rolling standard deviation of the close_location, we can differentiate between range-bound oscillation and directional expansion, prioritizing trades only when volatility-adjusted positioning signifies a breakout.
